title: Nepal Ft.Muktinath
shortDescription: A carefully curated 7N/8D women-only Nepal group trip covering Kathmandu – Pokhara – Jomsom – Muktinath – Kathmandu, blending spirituality, Himalayan landscapes, cultural heritage, and sisterhood in one unforgettable journey.
longDescription:
TripNaari’s Exploring Nepal tour is a thoughtfully designed women’s group experience that takes you through Nepal’s most iconic spiritual and scenic destinations. Begin in Kathmandu with the mesmerizing evening Aarati at Pashupatinath Temple, travel through river valleys and Himalayan foothills to the lakeside city of Pokhara, continue into the dramatic Mustang region to Jomsom and the sacred Muktinath Temple, and conclude with a heritage tour of Kathmandu’s UNESCO-listed spiritual landmarks.

The journey is ideal for women seeking a safe, well-organized, and enriching travel experience with a verified Trip Leader, comfortable stays, private transportation, and a supportive travel community.
highlights: Evening Sandhya Aarati at Pashupatinath Temple
Scenic drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara
Leisure time at Phewa Lake & Lakeside Market
Drive through the dramatic landscapes of Mustang
Pokhara sightseeing including Devi’s Fall & Gupteshwor Cave
Peaceful boat ride on Phewa Lake
itineraryChangePolicy: TripNaari reserves the right to modify the itinerary due to weather, road conditions, government restrictions, safety concerns, or operational requirements. Any changes will be communicated to travellers as early as possible, and suitable alternatives will be arranged wherever feasible. Safety and the overall travel experience of the group will always remain our highest priority.
inclusions: Comfortable private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
Accommodation in handpicked 3-star hotels and authentic homestays
Experienced and friendly TripNaari Trip Leader
7 breakfasts
1 special traditional dinner
Manakamana Cable Car tickets
All required permits
exclusions: Entry fees to monuments, museums, and attractions not included in the itinerary
Personal expenses (shopping, tips, laundry, beverages, etc.)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu & Pashupatinath Aarati
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Kathmandu International Airport and transfer to the hotel. In the evening, visit Pashupatinath Temple to witness the divine Sandhya Aarati on the banks of the Bagmati River. Overnight stay in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Pokhara, Nepal’s beautiful lake city. Enjoy scenic views of rivers, hills, villages, and Himalayan ranges along the way. Evening free for a walk around Phewa Lake and the vibrant Lakeside Market. Overnight stay in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Jomsom
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Jomsom, gateway to the Mustang region. Stop at the spectacular Rupse Waterfall en route. Enjoy dramatic mountain scenery and unique high-altitude landscapes before reaching Jomsom. Overnight stay in Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Muktinath Darshan & Return to Pokhara
itinerary.desc: Early morning drive to the sacred Muktinath Temple for darshan and puja. Experience the serene spiritual atmosphere surrounded by the Himalayas. Return to Jomsom for breakfast and continue driving back to Pokhara. Overnight stay in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Explore Pokhara’s major attractions including Bindabasini Temple, Seti River Gorge, Devi’s Fall, Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave, and Barahi Temple on Phewa Lake. Evening at leisure in Lakeside. Overnight stay in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Kathmandu via Manakamana
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive back to Kathmandu. En route, visit Manakamana Temple and enjoy the scenic cable car ride across lush valleys and rivers. Continue to Kathmandu and check in to the hotel. Overnight stay in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Kathmandu’s iconic spiritual landmarks: Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Budhanilkantha Temple, and Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple). Enjoy panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley and spend the evening shopping in local markets. Overnight stay in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, transfer to Kathmandu International Airport for your onward journey with beautiful memories and divine blessings from Nepal.

packingItems: Please pack light but smart, as temperatures can vary from pleasant in Kathmandu and Pokhara to quite cold in Jomsom and Muktinath.
Sturdy walking shoes or trekking shoes with good grip
Comfortable slippers / sandals for hotel use
Valid Government ID (Passport preferred for Nepal travel)
Travel pouch for documents and cash
Layering works best in Nepal. Carry 2–3 light warm layers instead of one very heavy outfit, and keep a warm jacket easily accessible during mountain drives.

title: Mystical Bhutan with TripNaari
shortDescription: Step into the magical Kingdom of Bhutan with TripNaari’s women-only group journey. From the peaceful monasteries of Tiger’s Nest and the cultural charm of Thimphu to the beautiful valleys of Paro and the scenic Himalayan landscapes, this trip is designed for women who seek culture, connection, serenity, and meaningful travel experiences.  Travel with a wonderful community of women, discover Bhutan’s unique traditions, explore monasteries and dzongs, enjoy mountain views, and create unforgettable memories together.
longDescription:
TripNaari’s Exploring Bhutan tour is a thoughtfully curated women’s group experience that introduces you to the spiritual heart of the Himalayas. Begin your journey through the tea gardens and forests of North Bengal before entering Bhutan through Phuntsholing. Travel onward to Thimphu, Bhutan’s charming capital, and explore its monasteries, cultural landmarks, and traditional streets.

Continue to the picturesque valley of Paro, home to ancient dzongs, museums, wooden bridges, and the world-famous Tiger’s Nest Monastery. The highlight of the journey is the scenic hike to Taktsang Monastery, dramatically perched on a cliffside above the Paro Valley.

Designed with safety, comfort, and sisterhood in mind, this women-only trip includes private transportation, handpicked stays, local guide assistance, Bhutan permit support, and a supportive TripNaari travel community throughout the journey.

6 Breakfasts
6 Dinners
Comfortable 3-star hotel accommodation on a twin-sharing basis
Experienced local tour guide throughout the trip

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhutan (Phuntsholing)
itinerary.desc: Arrive at NJP Railway Station, Siliguri, or Bagdogra Airport and begin your scenic drive to Phuntsholing through tea gardens and forested landscapes. Check in to the hotel and relax for the evening.
itinerary.stay: Park Hotel/ Central Hotel/ Gadhen Hotel

itinerary.title: Phuntsholing → Thimphu
itinerary.desc: Complete permit formalities and drive to Thimphu. En route, visit Karbandi Goenpa and stop at the scenic Wankha Waterfalls. Check in to the hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening in Thimphu.
itinerary.stay: Cholay Khangzang/ Ugyen Hotel/ Hotel Migmar

itinerary.title: Explore Thimphu
itinerary.desc: Visit Simtokha Dzong, Buddha Dordenma, Memorial Chorten, Simply Bhutan, Changangkha Lhakhang, and the Royal Takin Preserve. Spend the evening shopping at Norzin Lam and relaxing at Changjuel Park.
itinerary.stay: Cholay Khangzang/ Ugyen Hotel/ Hotel Migmar

itinerary.title: Thimphu → Paro
itinerary.desc: Drive to Paro with a stop at Chuzom, the confluence of two rivers, and the historic iron bridge. Visit Ta Dzong (National Museum), Paro Rinpung Dzong, and the iconic Nya-Mey Zam Wooden Bridge. Evening free to explore Paro Market.
itinerary.stay: Namsay Choling Hotel/ Hotel Center Point/ Hotel Gakyidaina

itinerary.title: Tiger’s Nest Hike
itinerary.desc: Embark on the iconic hike to Tiger’s Nest Monastery (Taktsang) through pine forests while enjoying spectacular views of the Paro Valley. Return to Paro in the evening and relax.
itinerary.stay: Namsay Choling Hotel/ Hotel Center Point/ Hotel Gakyidaina

itinerary.title: Paro → Phuntsholing /Bagdogra
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive back to Phuntsholing -Bagdogra. Check in to the hotel and relax after the journey.
itinerary.stay: Park Hotel/ Central Hotel/ Gadhen Hotel

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Bagdogra Airport or NJP Railway Station for your onward journey with beautiful memories of the Land of the Thunder Dragon.

hotels.name: Park Hotel/ Central Hotel/ Gadhen Hotel
Cholay Khangzang/ Ugyen Hotel/ Hotel Migmar/ Peaceful Resort
Namsay Choling Hotel/ Hotel Center Point/ Hotel Gakyidaina

packingItems: TripNaari Tip 💜: Carry comfortable walking shoes and warm layers, especially for the Tiger’s Nest hike and cooler mountain mornings.

title: Wayanad
shortDescription: Escape to the refreshing hills of Wayanad with TripNaari’s women-only group getaway. From breathtaking viewpoints and thrilling adventures to waterfalls, lakes, and tea plantation landscapes, this trip is designed for women who love nature, adventure, relaxation, and meaningful travel experiences.  Travel with a wonderful community of women, explore Wayanad’s scenic beauty, enjoy exciting activities, and create unforgettable memories together.
longDescription:
TripNaari’s Exploring Wayanad tour is a thoughtfully curated weekend escape for women seeking a perfect mix of nature, adventure, and relaxation. Begin your journey from Bangalore and travel through the beautiful landscapes of Kerala to Banasura Sagar Dam, one of India’s largest earth dams.

Experience the thrill of the 900 Kandi Glass Bridge, enjoy optional adventure activities such as the Longest Zip Line and Giant Swing, and witness the cascading beauty of Soochipara Waterfalls surrounded by lush forest. Stroll through the vibrant Wayanad Floating Market and conclude the trip with panoramic views from the unique Phantom Rock.

Designed with safety, comfort, and sisterhood in mind, this women-only trip includes private transportation, handpicked stays, entry tickets, and a supportive TripNaari Trip Leader throughout the journey.

itinerary.title: Bangalore → Wayanad
itinerary.desc: Begin your journey from Bangalore and drive to the beautiful hills of Wayanad. En route, visit Banasura Sagar Dam and enjoy its breathtaking surroundings. Check in to the hotel and relax for the evening.

itinerary.title: Adventure & Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, visit the famous 900 Kandi Glass Bridge and enjoy the thrill of optional activities such as the Longest Zip Line and Giant Swing overlooking lush tea plantations. Later, explore Soochipara Waterfalls and conclude the day with a visit to the vibrant Wayanad Floating Market. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phantom Rock & Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and visit Phantom Rock, known for its distinctive natural rock formation and panoramic views. Later, begin your return journey to Bangalore with wonderful memories of Wayanad.

title: Varanasi Prayagraj & Ayodhya
shortDescription: Embark on a soulful journey through the sacred heart of India with TripNaari’s women-only spiritual group tour. From the timeless ghats of Varanasi and the Buddhist heritage of Sarnath to the holy Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj and the divine atmosphere of Ayodhya, this journey is designed for women seeking spirituality, culture, history, peace, and meaningful connections.  Travel with a wonderful community of women, witness mesmerizing Ganga and Saryu Aartis, seek blessings at revered temples, explore ancient heritage sites, and create unforgettable memories together.
longDescription:
TripNaari’s Exploring Varanasi, Prayagraj & Ayodhya tour is a thoughtfully curated women’s group pilgrimage through some of India’s holiest destinations. Begin in Varanasi, one of the world’s oldest living cities, where the sacred Ganga flows past historic ghats and temples. Experience a serene boat ride and the divine Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat.

Continue your spiritual journey with VIP Darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, visits to revered temples, and an exploration of Sarnath, where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon. Travel onward to Prayagraj to visit the sacred Triveni Sangam, historic temples, and cultural landmarks. Conclude the journey in Ayodhya, the birthplace of Lord Rama, with darshan at Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple, Hanuman Garhi, and the peaceful Saryu Aarti.

Designed with safety, comfort, and sisterhood in mind, this women-only trip includes private transportation, handpicked stays, local assistance, temple experiences, and a supportive TripNaari Trip Leader throughout the journey.
itineraryChangePolicy: TripNaari reserves the right to modify the itinerary due to weather, road conditions, government restrictions, safety concerns, or operational requirements. Any changes will be communicated to travellers as early as possible, and suitable alternatives will be arranged wherever feasible. Safety and the overall travel experience of the group will always remain our highest priority.
inclusions: 4 nights accommodation (Varanasi – 2N, Prayagraj – 1N, Ayodhya – 1N)

exclusions: Personal expenses, shopping, laundry, and beverages
Tips and gratuities for drivers, guides, and hotel staff
Special puja arrangements or additional VIP darshan not mentioned in inclusions
Sparsh Darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple (subject to availability)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Varanasi
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Varanasi and transfer to the hotel. In the evening, enjoy a peaceful boat ride along the iconic 84 ghats and witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat. Later, explore Godowlia Market and enjoy Varanasi’s famous street food. Overnight stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Sacred Varanasi
itinerary.desc: Begin the day with VIP Darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple and blessings at Kal Bhairav Temple. Continue sightseeing with visits to Tulsi Manas Temple, Sankat Mochan Hanuman Mandir, Durga Kund Temple, Bharat Mata Mandir, and BHU Vishwanath Temple. Overnight stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Varanasi → Sarnath → Prayagraj
itinerary.desc: Visit Sarnath, where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon. Explore Dhamek Stupa, Ashoka Pillar, Archaeological Museum, and Mulagandha Kuti Vihar. Later, drive to Prayagraj and visit Triveni Sangam, Bade Hanuman Mandir, Akshay Vat, Saraswati Koop, Anand Bhawan, and view Allahabad Fort from outside. Overnight stay in Prayagraj.

itinerary.title: Prayagraj → Ayodhya
itinerary.desc: Drive to Ayodhya and check in to the hotel. Visit Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple and Hanuman Garhi. In the evening, attend the serene Saryu Aarti at Saryu Ghat. Overnight stay in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya Exploration & Departure
itinerary.desc: Enjoy a relaxed morning in Ayodhya before check-out. Transfer to Ayodhya Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with beautiful spiritual memories.

packingItems: TripNaari Tip 💜: Carry modest, comfortable clothing suitable for temple visits and easy walking through ghats and heritage areas.

title: Arunanchal Kaziranga
shortDescription: Popularly known as the Land of the Dawn-Lit Mountains, Arunachal Pradesh is India’s first state to greet the rising sun and is blessed with dramatic Himalayan scenery, pristine lakes, waterfalls, and vibrant Buddhist culture.
longDescription: Discover the magical beauty of Arunachal Pradesh and Assam on this unforgettable 6-day journey. From the snow-covered passes of Sela Pass and the monasteries of Tawang, to the serene valleys of Dirang and the wild landscapes of Kaziranga National Park, this trip is a perfect blend of mountains, culture, and wildlife.
itineraryChangePolicy: TripNaari reserves the right to modify the itinerary due to weather, road conditions, government restrictions, safety concerns, or operational requirements. Any changes will be communicated to travellers as early as possible, and suitable alternatives will be arranged wherever feasible. Safety and the overall travel experience of the group will always remain our highest priority.
inclusions: Guwahati airport pickup & drop
All transportation by private vehicle
Accommodation on twin sharing basis
Daily Breakfast And Dinner
Inner Line Permit (ILP)
Bumla Pass vehicle arrangement
Jeep safari in kaziranga national park
All Entry Tickets
Sightseeing as per itinerary
Trip leader assistance throughout the journey

itinerary.title: Arrival in Guwahati → Dirang
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Guwahati Airport by 10:00 AM and meet the TripNaari team. Begin your scenic drive towards Dirang, passing through lush tea gardens, river valleys, and picturesque hill roads. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you enter the Eastern Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Sangti Valley → Tawang
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, explore the beautiful Sangti Valley, known for its peaceful riverside setting and Himalayan views. Visit Dirang Monastery before continuing towards Tawang. En route, witness the breathtaking Sela Pass, Sela Lake, Jaswant Garh War Memorial, and the spectacular Jung (Nuranang) Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Bumla Pass & Lakes Excursion
itinerary.desc: Today is dedicated to the high-altitude wonders near the Indo-China border. Visit Bumla Pass (subject to permits and weather conditions), the stunning Madhuri Lake (Sangestar Tso), and PTSO Lake. Later, visit the Tawang War Memorial and enjoy the Light & Cultural Show in the evening.

itinerary.title: Chug Valley Excursion → Dirang
itinerary.desc: Enjoy a peaceful excursion to Chug Valley, a hidden Himalayan village known for its natural beauty and traditional culture. Return to Dirang by evening and unwind with a cozy bonfire gathering.

itinerary.title: Dirang → Bomdila → Kaziranga
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive through Bomdila and descend towards the plains of Assam. Continue to Kaziranga National Park, home to the famous one-horned rhinoceros. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Assamese cultural show at Orchid Garden.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga Safari → Guwahati Airport Drop
itinerary.desc: Start early for an exciting morning safari in Kaziranga National Park. Witness the rich wildlife, including rhinos, elephants, wild buffalo, deer, and numerous bird species — often referred to as the park’s “Big Five” experience. Later, visit a scenic tea estate before driving back to Guwahati Airport for your onward journey.

packingItems: Government ID proof (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID)

title: Hampi
shortDescription: Step into the timeless world of Hampi with TripNaari’s women-only group getaway. Explore ancient ruins, sacred hilltops, tranquil lakes, and the rich heritage of the Vijayanagara Empire while travelling with a wonderful community of women.  This short yet immersive journey combines spirituality, history, nature, photography, laughter, and meaningful connections—perfect for women who love discovering new places together.
longDescription:
TripNaari’s Exploring Hampi tour is a thoughtfully curated weekend escape for women who wish to experience the magic of one of India’s most iconic heritage destinations. Begin your journey from Bangalore and travel to Anjaneya Hills, believed to be the birthplace of Lord Hanuman, followed by the peaceful Sanapur Lake surrounded by Hampi’s famous boulder landscapes.

Spend a full day exploring the magnificent ruins of Hampi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its grand temples, royal enclosures, stone architecture, and fascinating history. Conclude the trip with a visit to the scenic Tungabhadra Dam before returning to Bangalore with unforgettable memories.

Designed with safety, comfort, and community in mind, this women-only group trip includes private transportation, handpicked stays, a local Hampi guide, and a supportive TripNaari Trip Leader throughout the journey.

title: Meghalaya & Kaziranga
shortDescription: A 6N/7D women-only Meghalaya & Kaziranga trip covering Shillong, Phe Phe Falls, Krang Suri Falls, Mawlynnong, Dawki, Cherrapunji, Double Decker Living Root Bridge, Laitlum Canyon, and Kaziranga National Park, with comfortable stays, private transportation, guided experiences, and a dedicated TripNaari Trip Leader.
longDescription:
TripNaari’s Exploring Meghalaya & Kaziranga tour is a thoughtfully curated women’s group experience that takes you through the most iconic destinations of Meghalaya and Assam. Begin in Shillong, the charming hill capital, and witness the beauty of Umiam Lake. Explore hidden gems like Phe Phe Falls and Krang Suri Falls, visit Mawlynnong, famously known as Asia’s Cleanest Village, and experience the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River in Dawki.

Continue to Cherrapunji, where lush valleys, caves, waterfalls, and the legendary Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek await. End the journey in Kaziranga National Park, home to the world-famous one-horned rhinoceros, with an exciting jeep safari and a traditional Assamese cultural evening.

Designed with safety, comfort, and community in mind, this women-only trip includes private transportation, handpicked stays, local guides, entry tickets, safari experience, and a supportive TripNaari Trip Leader throughout the journey.
highlights: Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek

itinerary.title: Guwahati → Shillong
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Guwahati Airport (pickup by 12:00 PM) and drive to Shillong. En route, stop at the picturesque Umiam Lake for photographs. Check in to the hotel and relax for the evening.

itinerary.title: Phe Phe Falls & Krang Suri Falls
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, visit the beautiful Phe Phe Falls in the Jaintia Hills, followed by the crystal-clear Krang Suri Falls, one of Meghalaya’s most scenic waterfalls. Return to Shillong in the evening.

itinerary.title: Mawlynnong & Dawki → Cherrapunji
itinerary.desc: Visit Mawlynnong, Asia’s Cleanest Village, and walk across the famous Single Living Root Bridge. Continue to Dawki and experience the crystal-clear Umngot River. Later, drive to Cherrapunji for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek
itinerary.desc: Begin early for the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek. After the trek, visit the majestic Nohkalikai Falls and enjoy panoramic valley views before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji Sightseeing → Shillong
itinerary.desc: Explore the highlights of Cherrapunji including Mawsmai Cave, Arwah Cave, Garden of Caves, and Seven Sisters Falls. Later, drive back to Shillong for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Laitlum Canyon → Kaziranga
itinerary.desc: Visit the breathtaking Laitlum Canyon (subject to accessibility). Continue your journey to Kaziranga National Park. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Assamese Cultural Show before checking in to the resort.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga Safari & Departure
itinerary.desc: Early morning, embark on an exciting Jeep Safari in Kaziranga National Park, famous for its one-horned rhinoceros, elephants, deer, wild buffalo, and rich birdlife. Return for breakfast and later transfer to Guwahati Airport for your onward journey
